summary: Lets players rob each other with the game's pickpocketing. The thief's game plays the minigame, and the server decides whether a theft may start and learns how it ended. The events are playerPickpocketStart, which can refuse, playerPickpocketCaught and playerPickpocketed.

enabled.summary: Whether the game offers Rob on other players.
enabled.exampleLua:
local Pickpocketing = kcds.players.Pickpocketing

if Pickpocketing.enabled then
  Pickpocketing.setEnabled(false)
end

setEnabled.summary: Offers or removes Rob on other players, for all players.

victimNotice.summary: Whether a player who catches a thief is told about it.
victimNotice.exampleLua:
local Pickpocketing = kcds.players.Pickpocketing

if not Pickpocketing.victimNotice then
  Pickpocketing.setVictimNotice(true)
end

victimNoticeText.summary: The notice's text, where {thief} is replaced by the thief's name. For each language, use the Locales key 'pickpocket.victimNotice'.

setVictimNotice.summary: Turns the notice on or off, optionally with new text.
setVictimNotice.example: kcds.players.Pickpocketing.setVictimNotice(true, '{thief} has a hand in your purse!');
setVictimNotice.exampleLua: kcds.players.Pickpocketing.setVictimNotice(true, "{thief} has a hand in your purse!")
setVictimNotice.exampleCs: Pickpocketing.SetVictimNotice(true, "{thief} has a hand in your purse!");
